_comment: Pieces to merge into the distribution config (get-distribution-config, edit, update-distribution with the ETag). Add the origin to Origins.Items and the behavior to CacheBehaviors.Items, raising each Quantity. FUNCTION_URL_HOST is the function URL's host name without https:// or the trailing slash; LAMBDA_OAC_ID is an Origin Access Control with OriginAccessControlOriginType lambda. The cache policy is the managed CachingDisabled; the origin request policy is the managed AllViewerExceptHostHeader, which passes the query string.

LambdaOac.Name: pta-search-relay
LambdaOac.Description: CloudFront signs requests to the search relay's function URL
